origin: BG3 Icon Pack by starpest; original artwork credited to Larian.
license: Original game assets; no independent redistribution license established.
matching: Original named icons are checked against BG3 spell identities and wiki artwork. mappingKind separates exact original icons from individually reviewed thematic replacements for spells absent from BG3; source names and reasons are retained.

icons.name: Chill Touch
icons.mappingReason: BG3 Bone Chill has the ChillTouch spell identity; the spectral skeletal hand depicts necrotic contact.
